## New look: glass
- **Menu on the left** – the top bar is gone. The menu is now a frosted glass panel on the left with icons for every tab; the logo and version sit at the top, Settings and the download/upload speeds at the bottom.
- **Glass frame behind the cards** – every tab sits on the same frosted, 70 % transparent glass panel with a thin light edge, so the dynamic background (poster wall, library images, aurora, …) shows through, softly blurred, while the cards stay easy to read.
- **Light themes** get a milky-glass variant; tint and glow theme options style the active menu item.
- **Phones and narrow windows** – a slim glass bar with ☰ opens the same menu over the page; tap outside it or press Esc to close.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.13.0   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept. If the page looks unchanged after upgrading, reload it once (Ctrl+F5).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.12.1...v1.13.0
